verdict.rationale: Homebrew is itself an official CLI (`brew`), documented in the Manpage. It has documented automation-friendly behavior: `NONINTERACTIVE=1` installs, `--yes` for scripted runs, `brew info --json` output, and a scriptable `brew bundle check || brew bundle install` pattern for CI and admin scripts. Community users corroborate everyday `brew upgrade` use. missing for 10: explicit agent- or AI-oriented CLI guidance, and machine-readable docs such as llms.txt (the probe returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use this from administrative scripts when the desktop user manages Homebrew, for example `brew as-console-user install --yes` formula.
List the `brew info --json` output for all current Homebrew/homebrew-core formulae or Homebrew/homebrew-cask casks.
You can use this behaviour in scripts like so: brew bundle check || brew bundle install
